name: products_sdk
_comment_requires: products_sdk >= 1.5.0 carries the int->String docname id migration for the seller authoring slice (Frappe hash docnames; fleet-wide sweep). products_sdk >= 1.2.0 requires base_sdk >= 1.5.0 (SyncEngine/SyncHandler APIs from the offline-first Phase 0, core PR #15); the composer manifest schema has no machine-readable minimum-version field, so this is the declaration.
_comment_app_type: manager: paas_manager's foods vertical - the foods/addons/extras tab page plus the create/edit product flows (details, units, categories, stocks, addons, extras groups) as bottom-sheet modals. The application layer, seller models, request shaping and repositories live in lib/src/manager/ + lib/src/common/ (landed in stages 1-3); declaring this block also keeps lib/src/manager/ alive through sdk_composer.py's strip_unused_role_folders. Everything here is tab- or modal-hosted, so 'routes' is deliberately empty - FoodsPage installs to lib/presentation/pages/foods/foods_page.dart and CreateProductModal / CreateAddonModal / CreateExtrasGroupModal to their sibling paths, which are exactly the import contracts of merchants_sdk's manager main_page.dart shell (its foods tab and FAB). foodTabsProvider drives that FAB's modal choice. The kitchen picker seam: the form templates import kitchen_sdk's kitchenPickerProvider directly (templates are host files; products_sdk's own lib never imports kitchen_sdk per ADR-005) and the edit body converts SellerProductKitchen -> KitchenModel at that boundary. Cross-vertical widgets referenced via ${package} host paths (custom_app_bar, custom_toggle, modal_drag/modal_wrap, underlined_text_field, loading_list/tab_bar_loading, categories_tab_bar, buttons_bouncing_effect from merchants' install) stay host-owned until the dedup workstream settles them. DID NOT PORT, on purpose: application/product (orders_sdk owns the POS food-details picker), the foods filter slice (dead code - modal never opened, repository calls commented out), the standalone AddFoodCategoryModal and IngredientPage (unreferenced in the app). Requires .rokct/config/app_type = manager. Version bumped 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0 so version-aware cache reconciliation re-extracts composed copies.
_comment_tr_keys: Declared here rather than hand-written into base_sdk because only this SDK uses them (kitchen_sdk's mechanism/comment) - checked against base_sdk's hand-written keys, orders_sdk's 39 manager keys and kitchen_sdk's two. Keys this vertical uses that orders_sdk already declares (outOfStock, pending, published) or kitchen_sdk declares (kitchen, kitchens) are intentionally NOT redeclared - the installer resolves a double declaration by silently keeping whichever it sees first, so each key keeps exactly one declaring SDK; if a future flavor composes products_sdk without those SDKs, promote the shared keys to base_sdk by hand. Values are paas_manager's legacy wire keys verbatim.
_comment_components: Installed to lib/presentation/components/foods/ (orders_sdk's components/orders/ convention). food_item.dart and products_body.dart are the seller-model halves of widgets orders_sdk also installs under components/orders/ typed on its POS models - same legacy widget, split by the per-SDK model split; never imported together. Reconciling them onto one shared model is a dedup-workstream item.
